881aeb49f3bf0428.description: Job Title: Senior Tendering Specialist – Medical Sector Department: Sales Operations / Commercial Location: [Riyadh], Saudi Arabia Reports To: [e.g., Commercial Director / General Manager] Employment Type: Full-Time Role Overview We are seeking a highly meticulous and strategic Senior Tendering Specialist to manage our public and private sector bidding operations in Saudi Arabia. In the highly competitive medical supplies, devices, and pharmaceutical sector, you will serve as the central hub for all tender activities. You will leverage your 5 to 10 years of specialized experience to navigate complex government procurement portals (specifically Etimad and NUPCO) and manage the end-to-end bid lifecycle. The ideal candidate will combine sharp commercial acumen with an expert understanding of Saudi procurement laws, SFDA regulatory requirements, and Local Content mandates to maximize our tender win rates and drive revenue growth. Key Responsibilities Tender Preparation & Submission Portal Management: Actively monitor, identify, and evaluate relevant tender opportunities across government portals (Etimad, NUPCO) and private hospital procurement platforms (e.g., Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib, NGHA, MODA). End-to-End Bid Management: Lead the full lifecycle of tender submissions, from initial review and purchasing of tender documents (RFP/RFQ) to the final compilation of technical and commercial offers. Documentation & Accuracy: Ensure all bid submissions are 100% accurate, fully compliant with the tender’s scope of work, and submitted well before strict government deadlines. Local Content Compliance: Work closely with internal teams to calculate and integrate the Local Content baseline and target scores into government bids, ensuring strict alignment with the Local Content and Government Procurement Authority (LCGPA) regulations. Cross-Functional Coordination Technical Alignment: Collaborate with the Sales, Product Management, and Regulatory Affairs teams to gather accurate product specifications, SFDA registration certificates (MDMA), and clinical catalogs required for the technical bid. Pricing Strategy: Partner with the Finance and Sales Directors to develop highly competitive pricing strategies, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), and profit margin analyses for each bid. Supply Chain Synchronization: Verify stock availability, lead times, and cold-chain logistics capabilities with the Supply Chain team to ensure we can meet the tender’s delivery schedules without incurring penalties. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Tender Win Rate: Increase the percentage of successful bids across both NUPCO and private sector RFPs. Submission Compliance: Maintain a 100% compliance rate with zero tender rejections due to missing documents, expired certificates, or late submissions. Margin Protection: Ensure submitted pricing strictly adheres to the approved gross margin targets while remaining competitive. Bond Recovery: Achieve a timely return rate for expired bid bonds to optimize the company’s working capital and bank credit limits. Qualifications & Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Pharmacy, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field. Experience: 5 to 10 years of direct experience in tender management, pricing, or commercial operations specifically within the KSA medical, pharmaceutical, or healthcare distribution industry . Portal Expertise: Hands-on, expert-level proficiency in navigating the Etimad platform and NUPCO procurement cycles. Regulatory Knowledge: Strong understanding of Saudi Government Tenders and Procurement Law, LCGPA mandates, and SFDA documentation requirements. Language Skills: Exceptional, professional fluency in both Arabic and English is mandatory . The ability to read complex legal/government documents in Arabic and translate technical requirements into English is critical. Core Competencies Meticulous attention to detail and high organizational skills under strict, non-negotiable deadlines. Strong analytical and mathematical skills for BOQ pricing, margin calculations, and tender cost estimations. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables) and ERP/CRM systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce). Excellent communication and negotiation skills to align multiple internal departments toward a single submission deadline.

88d5f3f7b2410acf.description: About Four Seasons Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us. About the location: Soon to be one of the region’s foremost luxury beachside destinations, The Red Sea will comprise of the idyllic natural islands and lagoons across 200 kms of coastline along the western coast of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, between the cities of Umluj and Al Wajh. The new Four Seasons Resort will be located on Shura Island, the hub of the development and home to a yacht marina, leisure and lifestyle facilities, retail offerings, 18-hole golf course and more. The Red Sea destination is being built with sustainable practices and tourism at its core, with the masterplan being informed by an impressive marine spatial planning simulation to model the environmental impact of development and operations to minimize over-tourism while providing guests with an exceptional travel and lifestyle experience. The destination will also rely on renewable energy and will only develop a small portion of the islands with expansive dedicated conservation zones. The new Four Seasons Resort will offer approximately 149 rooms and suites, all with uninterrupted views over white sand beaches and crystal-clear waters. The property will also feature six restaurant and lounge outlets, meeting and events spaces, a marine discovery centre, Kids for All Seasons space and much more. Whether looking for rest and relaxation or sport and water activities, there will be something for everyone, including a full-service spa with a hammam, tennis courts, three outdoor pools with cabanas, and two separate beaches for families and adults perfect for soaking in the sun or diving down to explore the coral reefs. The Role Of Assistant Director Of Engineering We currently have an opportunity for Assistant Director of Engineering to join our Four Seasons Resort at The Red Sea opening team! Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you will be an integral member of the Engineering team that is collectively responsible for making key strategic and operational decisions for the hotel. You will also lead the Safety Committee and the energy conservation program. Critical to the success of the role is the accomplishment of all responsibilities in conjunction with talent leadership and development, delivering the highest of standards consistently and ensuring the safety and comfort of our guests and employees. Our Ideal Assistant Director Of Engineering Candidate Will Have Hotel opening experience and expert technical knowledge of general building maintenance and environmental standards. Additionally, you will be a passionate and motivated leader with excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills, have the highest level of integrity and transparency, strategic, analytical and strong business acumen, an eye for detail, a passion for service, and a desire to promote a continuous learning environment that creates an atmosphere for professional development opportunities. Suitable candidates must be eligible to work in The Red Sea, Saudi Arabia. Fluency in Arabic and English is essential. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts can offer what many hospitality professionals dream of; the opportunity to build a life-long career with global potential and a real sense of pride in work well done. We look for talent who share the Golden Rule – people who, by nature, believe in treating others as we would have them treat us. As Four Seasons works towards phenomenal growth in the next decade, our most valuable partners continue to be our talent, with whom we have a strong relationship based on the Golden Rule. This relationship is made tangible by the awards received year after year by Four Seasons on a corporate level, as well as by our hotels, resorts and residences around the world, making us an undisputed “employer of choice.”

884e2b3c0c79f994.description: You'll own the online systems that take a catalogue change to a ranked result in front of a shopper: search, retrieval and recommendation serving, the streaming data that keeps them fresh, and the experiments that ship them. Salla is the leading e-commerce platform in MENA, serving about 68,000+ merchants. Our AI team is building a self-owned discovery stack across our marketplace and merchant stores: hybrid lexical and vector search, Arabic-first query understanding, and learned ranking shared between search and recommendations. The work is roughly half online serving, a third streaming data, and the rest integration into product surfaces. You sit on the ML Platform team spending time between search and serving for our recommendation systems and work day to day with search data scientists and the ranking lead What you'll do Online serving Build and run query and recommendation serving: retrieval, score fusion, filtering, caching. Hold tight latency budgets, including double-digit-millisecond p95 for search-as-you-type. Design graceful degradation, so serving holds up when a model or vector path is slow or down. Build experiment plumbing: shadow traffic, A/B assignment, guardrail metrics, rollback. Streaming data Build change-data-capture from source systems into search indexes and feature stores, with measured freshness. Keep embeddings fresh for new and updated items. Run zero-downtime reindexing of multi-million-document collections. Build feature logging that turns production traffic into training data for ranking models. Integration Ship changes into product teams' backends and clients: new endpoints, cutovers, experiment flags. Work with product engineering teams on reviews, release windows and production ownership. Operability, throughout Monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and your share of on-call for what you ship. 5+ years building backend or platform systems in production. 2+ years operating a production search engine (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr, Typesense, Vespa or similar): index lifecycle, analyzers, reindexing at scale, debugging relevance issues with data scientists. Low-latency services under real traffic, and the ability to explain where the p95 goes. Streaming ingestion: Kafka, Debezium or similar change-data-capture, plus idempotent backfills. Strong Python. Comfortable shipping in TypeScript. Shipped changes through A/B tests and staged rollouts. Daily use of agentic coding tools such as Claude Code. We expect one engineer plus agents to cover what used to take a team.

88fce7fed36589ab.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة Ninja (quick-commerce) عن موظف متخصص في العلاقات الحكومية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى إدارة المعاملات الحكومية اليومية وضمان الامتثال للمتطلبات واللوائح، بالإضافة إلى الحفاظ على سريان تراخيص الشركة وتصاريحها، بما في ذلك تراخيص المصانع والشهادات الصحية للعمالة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إصدار وتجديد التراخيص والتصاريح الحكومية اللازمة لعمليات الشركة. تجديد رخص البلدية، وتراخيص الهيئة العامة للنقل (TGA)، والدفاع المدني، وتراخيص المصانع. استخراج وتجديد الشهادات الصحية للعمالة والتأكد من صلاحيتها بشكل مستمر. متابعة المخالفات والغرامات الحكومية والعمل على معالجتها وإغلاقها ضمن الأطر الزمنية المحددة. تنفيذ المعاملات الحكومية عبر المنصات الإلكترونية مثل قوى، ومقيم، وأبشر أعمال، وبلدي، وسلامة، ووزارة الاستثمار (MISA)، وغيرها من المنصات الحكومية ذات الصلة. التنسيق الفعال مع الجهات الحكومية فيما يتعلق بالتراخيص، المخالفات، عمليات التفتيش، والمتطلبات التنظيمية. متابعة تواريخ انتهاء صلاحية التراخيص والتصاريح والشهادات الصحية، وضمان تجديدها في الوقت المناسب لتجنب أي انقطاع. حفظ وتحديث سجلات المستندات الحكومية، التراخيص، المخالفات، والمعاملات ذات الصلة بشكل دقيق ومنظم. التأكد من الالتزام التام بالأنظمة واللوائح الحكومية ومتطلبات إصدار التراخيص لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 6 سنوات في مجال العلاقات الحكومية أو ما يعادله. فهم عميق للأنظمة واللوائح الحكومية في المملكة العربية السعودية. القدرة على التعامل مع المنصات الحكومية الإلكترونية المختلفة بكفاءة. نوع العمل والموقع هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يتطلب الدور التواجد في الموقع للتعامل مع الجهات الحكومية والمعاملات اليومية. عن الشركة Ninja هي شركة رائدة في مجال التجارة السريعة (quick-commerce)، وتسعى باستمرار لتعزيز عملياتها وضمان الامتثال التنظيمي في جميع جوانب أعمالها. تقديم الطلبات إذا كنت تمتلك الخبرة والمؤهلات المطلوبة لهذا الدور، ندعوك للتقديم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة الخطوات التالية في عملية التوظيف.

Create innovative graphic designs for social media platforms, which enhances interaction with the audience and contributes to increasing brand awareness. Collaborate with the marketing team to understand client needs and develop designs that effectively meet those needs. Review submitted designs and provide suggestions for improvement, which contributes to enhancing the quality of final work. Participate in brainstorming sessions to generate new and innovative ideas, which enhances team spirit and strengthens relationships among members. Develop engaging visual content that reflects the company's identity and values, which helps strengthen communication with clients. Organize files and designs in a way that facilitates access to them, which eases teamwork and increases team efficiency. Keep up with modern trends in graphic design and technology, ensuring that our designs remain current and appealing. 88ca481bd136faf4.job_title: إعلان صندوق البيئة عن وظيفة أخصائي أول التسويق
88ca481bd136faf4.description: إعلان صندوق البيئة عن وظيفة أخصائي أول التسويق المهام الوظيفية: دعم تخطيط وتنفيذ الحملات التسويقية عبر قنوات متعددة بما يتماشى مع الخطط المعتمدة. التنسيق مع الفرق الداخلية والوكالات الخارجية لضمان تنفيذ الأنشطة في الوقت المحدد. متابعة سير الحملات وضمان جاهزية المواد التسويقية قبل الإطلاق. المساهمة في تقييم نتائج الحملات واستخلاص الدروس المستفادة. تطوير وإعداد المحتوى التسويقي بالتعاون مع أصحاب المصلحة المعنيين لضمان اتساق الرسالة. مراجعة المواد التسويقية لضمان توافقها مع الهوية المؤسسية، ودعم إنتاج المواد الإبداعية (بما في ذلك الأصول الرقمية والمواد المطبوعة والعروض التقديمية)، والحفاظ على مكتبة المواد التسويقية وتحديثها باستمرار. دعم تخطيط وتنفيذ الفعاليات والمعارض والمؤتمرات. التنسيق مع الموردين والمنظمين لضمان التنفيذ بجودة عالية، ومتابعة الجوانب اللوجستية والتسويقية المتعلقة بالفعاليات. تطبيق إرشادات الهوية المؤسسية على جميع المواد والقنوات ومراقبة أي سوء استخدام للعلامة التجارية والإبلاغ عنه. دعم المبادرات التي تعزز صورة الجهة وسمعتها. التنسيق مع الإدارات الداخلية لفهم ودعم الاحتياجات التسويقية. التواصل مع الوكالات والموردين لضمان تسليم المخرجات المطلوبة. دعم بناء علاقات عمل فعالة مع الشركاء، وإعداد تقارير دورية حول أداء الحملات والأنشطة التسويقية. تحليل البيانات لاستخلاص رؤى تدعم تحسين الأداء، وتحديث لوحات البيانات وضمان دقتها. ضمان الامتثال للسياسات والمعايير التنظيمية عند تنفيذ الأنشطة التسويقية. ضمان توافق المحتوى مع الإرشادات الثقافية والتنظيمية، ودعم عمليات المشتريات والامتثال لحقوق الملكية الفكرية. الشروط: المؤهل العلمي درجة البكالوريوس أو الدبلوم في التسويق، أو الاتصالات، أو إدارة الأعمال، أو الإعلام، أو أي مجال ذي صلة. سنوات الخبرة: خبرة متدرجة لا تقل عن سنتين في مجالات التسويق، أو بناء العلامة التجارية، أو الاتصالات، أو التسويق الرقمي، أو استراتيجيات الفعاليات لحاملي درجة البكالوريوس؛ أو خبرة متدرجة لا تقل عن 4 سنوات لحاملي الدبلوم في المجالات نفسها. نبذة عن الصندوق: سعياً لتحقيق أهداف رؤية المملكة 2030 فإن صندوق البيئة يهدف إلى المساهمة في الإستدامة المالية لقطاعي البيئة والأرصاد وتوفير الممكنات اللازمة للنهوض به من خلال الاستثمار الأمثل لرأس ماله ودعم البرامج والدراسات والمبادرات البيئية وتحفيز التقنيات الصديقة للبيئة والارتقاء بالأداء البيئي.

883acbe66d259a2b.description: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Cyber Security Manager to lead cybersecurity operations, governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance across PayLink's payment platforms and technology infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of cybersecurity experience within SAMA-licensed financial institutions or FinTech companies , with demonstrated hands-on experience implementing SAMA cybersecurity requirements, managing security operations, responding to security incidents, and leading cybersecurity initiatives. Key Responsibilities Cybersecurity Governance & SAMA Compliance Develop, implement, and maintain cybersecurity policies, procedures, standards, and controls aligned with the SAMA Cyber Security Framework (CSF) and applicable regulatory requirements. Lead cybersecurity risk assessments, compliance reviews, internal audits, and remediation activities. Maintain cybersecurity governance documentation, risk registers, and compliance reporting. Identify regulatory compliance gaps and develop corrective action plans. Security Operations & Incident Response Oversee daily security operations, threat monitoring, detection, and incident response activities. Manage security monitoring solutions, including SIEM, EDR/XDR, firewalls, and intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS) . Lead cybersecurity incident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions. Develop, maintain, and test incident response procedures and escalation processes. Network, Application & Infrastructure Security Oversee network security controls, firewall configurations, access management, and infrastructure protection. Collaborate with development teams to integrate security into the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) . Ensure appropriate security controls are implemented across web applications, APIs, mobile applications, and payment platforms. Support secure architecture reviews, application security assessments, and penetration testing activities. Vulnerability & Risk Management Lead vulnerability assessments, security testing, and remediation tracking. Evaluate cybersecurity risks across applications, networks, cloud environments, and third-party integrations. Coordinate with IT and engineering teams to remediate critical vulnerabilities within defined timelines. Monitor emerging cyber threats and recommend preventive security measures. Leadership & Security Awareness Lead cybersecurity initiatives, manage security projects, and mentor cybersecurity team members. Coordinate with IT, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, and business stakeholders. Develop and deliver cybersecurity awareness and training programs. Prepare cybersecurity KPIs, risk reports, and security posture updates for senior management. Saudi nationality is mandatory. Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology , or a related field. Professional cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CEH , or equivalent are preferred. . Minimum 5 years of relevant cybersecurity or information security experience within SAMA-licensed financial institutions, banks, payment service providers, or FinTech companies in Saudi Arabia. Proven hands-on experience implementing and maintaining controls aligned with the SAMA Cyber Security Framework (SAMA CSF) . Demonstrated experience in Cybersecurity Governance, Risk Management, and Compliance (GRC) , including risk assessments, regulatory audits, and remediation plans. Proven experience managing Security Operations (SOC), security monitoring, and cybersecurity incident response . Strong technical knowledge of Network Security, Application Security, Vulnerability Management, and Security Architecture . Hands-on experience with cybersecurity technologies such as SIEM, EDR/XDR, firewalls, IDS/IPS, and vulnerability scanning tools . Experience conducting or overseeing vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and security remediation activities. Demonstrated experience leading cybersecurity projects, coordinating technical teams, or managing cybersecurity professionals. Strong communication, analytical, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

8805eb3bb3dcc549.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تقنيات وبيانات لتقنية نظم المعلومات عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على بناء وتوسيع قاعدة عملاء الشركة في قطاع تقنية المعلومات، مع التركيز على عملاء الشركات. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة ببيع مجموعة واسعة من الخدمات التقنية، بدءاً من تطوير البرمجيات وصولاً إلى حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي وإدارة البيانات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية توليد العملاء المحتملين وتحديد الفرص التجارية الجديدة. تقديم الخدمات، قيادة عملية المبيعات، وإنشاء وتقديم المقترحات، وإتمام الصفقات. العمل عن كثب مع رئيس تطوير الأعمال لدعم دورة المبيعات وإدارة الحسابات. التعاون مع فريق دعم ما قبل البيع الفني لإعداد المقترحات الفنية والرد على طلبات تقديم العروض (RFPs). العمل على بوابة اعتماد لتحديد طلبات تقديم العروض ذات الصلة وتقديم المقترحات عليها. تقديم الدعم والتنسيق العام لأي عملاء محتملين ومبيعات داخل الشركة. العمل بفعالية باستخدام برامج MS Word و Excel و Powerpoint. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنوات في مبيعات تقنية المعلومات مع عملاء الشركات في الرياض. يمكن للخريجين الجدد التقديم. درجة علمية في علوم الحاسب/الأنظمة/الهندسة أو الهندسة الصناعية. إتقان اللغة العربية تحدثاً وكتابة (يفضل أن يكون المتقدم سعودياً). مهارات ممتازة في التواصل الشفهي والكتابي باللغة الإنجليزية. المهارات والمعرفة المطلوبة القدرة على توليد العملاء المحتملين، تقديم العروض البيعية، إعداد المقترحات الفنية، التفاوض، وإغلاق صفقات الشركات. معرفة وفهم في مجالات الخدمات التقنية مثل تطوير البرمجيات، تكامل الأنظمة، تطوير حالات استخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي، تطبيقات السحابة، أنظمة إدارة علاقات العملاء (CRMs)، أنظمة تخطيط موارد المؤسسات (ERPs)، وإدارة البيانات. فهم آليات العمل على بوابة اعتماد، وإعداد وتقديم مقترحات الرد على طلبات تقديم العروض (RFPs). امتلاك علاقات جيدة وموثوقة مع عملاء الشركات والقدرة على تحديد احتياجاتهم من الخدمات والحلول. مهارات ممتازة في استخدام برامج MS Word و Excel و Powerpoint. بيئة العمل ستوفر الشركة هيكل راتب تنافسي بالإضافة إلى حوافز لهذا الدور. نحن نبحث عن أفراد لديهم الرغبة في النمو المهني من خلال العمل الجاد والالتزام. يخدم فريقنا العملاء في جميع احتياجاتهم التقنية، مما يوفر للموظف تعرضاً وخبرة شاملة في العمل مع Techdata.

88a4659770ce402c.job_title: IT Solution Analyst - Business Solutions (eCommerce & Marketplace)
88a4659770ce402c.description: We are looking for an experienced IT Solution Analyst – Business Solutions to support the eMarketPlace platform and related digital commerce solutions. The role will be responsible for understanding business requirements, translating them into scalable technology solutions, supporting solution design and implementation, and working closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver effective eCommerce and marketplace capabilities . The ideal candidate should have strong experience in eMarketPlace solutions, commerce solutions, eCommerce platforms, CommerceTools, MACH architecture, guided buying, and eCatalogue solutions . Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities Analyze business requirements and translate them into functional and technical solution requirements. Support the design, implementation, and enhancement of eMarketPlace and eCommerce solutions . Work closely with business stakeholders to understand business processes, pain points, and future requirements. Define solution approaches that align with business objectives, enterprise architecture, security, integration, and technology standards. Support the implementation and optimization of CommerceTools and other commerce-related platforms. Work with solution architects, developers, product owners, vendors, and business teams throughout the solution lifecycle. Analyze existing systems and processes and identify opportunities for improvement, automation, and digital transformation. Support MACH architecture principles, including Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, and Headless approaches. Support guided buying capabilities and digital procurement/customer purchasing journeys. Define and document requirements for eCatalogue solutions, product information, pricing, availability, and related marketplace capabilities. Develop functional specifications, user stories, process flows, use cases, and acceptance criteria. Support integration requirements between the marketplace/eCommerce platform and enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, PIM, payment, logistics, identity, and other business applications. Participate in solution evaluations, technical discussions, proof-of-concepts, and vendor assessments. Work with development and testing teams to ensure that delivered solutions meet business and functional requirements. Support system testing, UAT, defect resolution, deployment, and post-production stabilization. Identify risks, dependencies, gaps, and opportunities associated with proposed solutions. Ensure that solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise technology standards. Prepare solution documentation and maintain relevant technical and functional artifacts. Provide ongoing support and continuous improvement for eMarketPlace and commerce solutions. 5–7 years of relevant experience in IT business solutions, solution analysis, eCommerce, digital commerce, marketplace, or related domains. Strong experience with eMarketPlace solutions and commerce platforms . Hands-on or strong functional experience with CommerceTools . Strong understanding of eCommerce and digital commerce architectures . Experience with MACH architecture and modern headless commerce concepts. Experience with guided buying and digital purchasing/procurement journeys. Experience with eCatalogue solutions and product/catalog management. Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and translating business requirements into technology solutions.

8889f635c3fda7e4.description: About Mace Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to enhance project potential. The company's values guide its approach and define the professionals it seeks to join its team. This role is part of a large-scale program in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, focusing on a major mixed-use development. Role Overview Mace is seeking a Senior Project Manager (Hotel Delivery) to join its project management team. This full-time position involves working on a high-profile mixed-use development currently in the construction phase. The Senior Project Manager will act as part of the program delivery partner organization, leading the delivery of major building works from construction through to testing, commissioning, handover, and close-out. Key Responsibilities Manage the delivery of a major building package through construction and handover phases. Coordinate contractors, consultants, specialists, and internal project controls teams to achieve program objectives. Monitor construction progress against approved schedules and identify mitigation measures. Ensure all works comply with contractual obligations, quality standards, safety requirements, and project procedures. Chair project meetings and provide clear reporting on progress, risks, issues, opportunities, and key decisions. Review contractor programs, methodologies, recovery plans, and resource strategies. Drive proactive risk management and resolve technical, commercial, and operational issues. Oversee testing, commissioning, snagging, and project close-out activities. Support governance processes, approvals, and project reporting requirements. Foster a collaborative working environment among all project stakeholders. Champion health, safety, sustainability, and quality performance throughout delivery. Mentor and support project managers and other junior team members. 887a4547df900e1a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رائدة في المنطقة الشرقية عن موظف مبيعات وتسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقات المهنية، بالإضافة إلى الترويج لمنتجات وخدمات الشركة وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. يشمل النطاق الجغرافي للدور مدن الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، الهفوف، بقيق، راس تنورة، الخفجي، قرية العليا، النعيرية، صفوى، القطيف، سيهات، تاروت، الجش، عنك، دارين، أم الحمام، جواثا، المبرز، العمران، والجفر. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية رئيسية في تنمية الأعمال من خلال استقطاب العملاء الجدد وبناء علاقات قوية معهم. كما يساهم في تنفيذ الأنشطة التسويقية التي تدعم نمو الشركة وتوسع قاعدة عملائها، مع التركيز على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات تطوير مبيعات B2B في مجال خدمات الموارد البشرية. استقطاب العملاء من قطاع الأعمال وبناء علاقات مهنية مستدامة معهم. الترويج لخدمات الشركة بفعالية وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. متابعة فرص البيع المحتملة حتى إتمام التعاقد بنجاح. المساهمة في تنمية قاعدة العملاء وتوسيع نطاق الأعمال. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات والتسويق. القدرة على استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقات المهنية. مهارات قوية في التفاوض وإتمام الصفقات. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية بالمملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتوسيع نطاق أعمال الشركة في قطاع خدمات الموارد البشرية. معلومات إضافية اسم الشركة محجوب من قبل صاحب العمل، وسيتم الكشف عنه للمرشحين المؤهلين. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

889e0b1343400cda.description: About Hala Hala is a leading fintech company in the MENAP region focused on redefining financial services for Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs). The company aims to empower SMEs by providing financial and technological tools to support their business operations. Hala operates multiple entities in UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Egypt, offering solutions for payment digitization, sales management, and operational control. Founded in 2017, Hala is licensed by the Saudi Arabian Central Bank. The Role of Sanctions Officer As a Sanctions Officer at Hala in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, your primary responsibility will be to conduct sanctions screening and investigations. This full-time role involves identifying potential sanctions matches, ensuring timely regulatory compliance, supporting transaction monitoring, and maintaining accurate documentation in accordance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. This position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Conduct sanctions name screening for new and existing customers, transactions, employees, and third parties. Analyze alerts generated by screening systems to assess the level of match (False Match / True Match). Perform necessary investigations for potential matches, gathering supporting evidence and information before escalating to the Sanctions Manager. Execute instructions to stop or suspend transactions when required. Update screening records and ensure complete and accurate documentation. Implement freezing or temporary blocking of transactions or accounts upon confirmed matches, in accordance with approved policies and procedures. Update and review approved sanctions lists within the system, ensuring timely reflection of regulatory updates. Maintain strict confidentiality of information related to sanctions cases. Support the execution of requests from competent authorities related to specific sanctions cases, in accordance with approved authorities. Contribute to the reduction of false positives by providing practical feedback to enhance screening criteria and parameters. Conduct periodic rescreening of existing customers upon updates to sanctions lists or changes in customer data. Support sanctions screening system effectiveness testing by reviewing samples and validating match results. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field, demonstrating a strong understanding of sanctions regulations and compliance procedures. You will be detail-oriented, analytical, and capable of conducting thorough investigations while maintaining confidentiality. Work Environment and Culture Hala fosters an inclusive and diverse culture that supports innovation and flexibility across remote, in-office, and hybrid work setups. The company emphasizes personal development through regular training and an annual learning stipend. You will join a team comprising over 30 nationalities working across 7 countries, gaining experience in a growth-oriented environment. Hala promotes autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals, providing opportunities for professional growth. Compensation Hala offers competitive compensation packages, which may include the potential for shares.

The project aims to establish a global landmark in Riyadh, providing a distinct and self-sustaining hub with iconic assets. The role ensures accurate status reports to facilitate timely decisions, prevent schedule slippage and cost overruns, and produce comprehensive close-out reports for each project. KBR provides PMO services, enterprise-level governance, assurance, integration, and performance oversight across all projects and programs for this significant development. Key Responsibilities Assist in developing and implementing standard cost and commercial reporting formats for PMCs. Collaborate with PMCs to monitor construction progress by measuring and evaluating installed quantities against planned quantities. Coordinate with PMCs to compile and validate analytical commercial data. Provide analytical data for executive risk reporting. Assist in developing Project Cost Reports (PCR), Commercial Executive Reports, and Cashflows within Unifier, ensuring integration with other platforms for data consistency. Review existing procurement guidelines for Bills of Quantities (BoQ) and tender documents to develop standards for PMCs. Support the preparation of consolidated cost reports consistent with agreed reporting requirements. Assist in collating annual program-wide budgets and preparing monthly cashflow reports for client submission. Contribute to the preparation and development of cost benchmark reports, including Tender Price Index, Professional Fees Benchmark, Construction Cost Benchmark for above-ground assets and infrastructure, and efficiency benchmarks. Prepare cost benchmarking templates, elemental cost plan formats, and required information for PMCs. Participate in the development and implementation of program change control procedures. Assist with the preparation of project Cash Flow Reports and project cost reports, including trend analysis and change reporting. Review cost risks and opportunities. Report seamlessly between Cost Break Down Structure and Work Breakdown Structure, linking Cost and Schedule, including Earned Value. Prepare updates for changes on the Programme baseline budget supporting the Business Plan exercise. Support weekly, monthly, and quarterly project progress meetings. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in quantity surveying or a related commercial role. Required Competencies Leadership capabilities. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Commercial awareness. Strong client focus. Effective planning and organizing skills. Demonstrated ability to accept responsibility. HSE Awareness. 88da3fecdc3e20e2.description: About Extend Extend is a Saudi cultural intelligence and advertising company established in 2012. The company serves leading brands and institutions across the Kingdom in experiences, media, and publishing. Extend is currently developing Extend CIP, a Cultural Intelligence Platform designed to plan, manage, and measure all media activity, both earned and paid, with cultural intelligence and AI at its core. This platform encompasses media and influencer buying, alongside a brand monitoring suite. The Role Extend is seeking a Data Quality & AI Operations Manager to oversee content and data operations for the Extend platform. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, involves building and maintaining accurate profiling processes, leveraging AI fine-tuning to automate manual annotation, and leading the content operations team. The manager will be responsible for the evaluation and data feedback loop, with success measured by golden-set accuracy and profile automation rate. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain golden sets and evaluation suites, defining acceptance criteria for each AI Admin iteration. Manage the data aspects of AI Admin iterations, including curating training and evaluation data, running benchmarks, analyzing failure modes, and collaborating with Shanghai engineering on fine-tuning and deployment. Design the human-in-the-loop (HITL) mechanism, establishing the boundary between human review and auto-approval, and integrating human corrections into prompts, evaluation sets, and training data. Author and maintain Arabic/English labeling guidelines, adjudicating edge cases that require cultural and linguistic judgment. Lead the content operations team, ensuring end-to-end ownership of annotation operations, including rater training, workflows, throughput, and quality SLAs. Establish and track a quality metrics framework, covering accuracy, automation rate, inter-annotator agreement, cost, and turnaround per profile. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated ability to manage data operations and AI fine-tuning processes. Experience in leading teams and managing quality metrics. Proficiency in both Arabic and English for guideline authoring and cultural/linguistic judgment. The role involves working within a dynamic environment focused on cultural intelligence and advertising, with a strong emphasis on AI-driven solutions.
